paths.name: drizzle-orm/neon-serverless
paths.message: Don't connect straight to Neon — direct neon-serverless connections bypass Hyperdrive and keep Neon's compute awake (autosuspend defeated, compute quota burned). Route Postgres through Hyperdrive via getPooledDb / getPooledDbWith from @garden/db/runtime, passing env.HYPERDRIVE.connectionString.

paths.name: @neondatabase/serverless
paths.message: Don't use the Neon serverless driver directly — it bypasses Hyperdrive and burns Neon compute. Go through @garden/db/runtime (Hyperdrive-backed node-postgres).
